correctness.rationale: For all 0<gamma<1, rho>0, and fixed integer n>=1, the bounded discrete Dirichlet heat equation for the Glauber correlator has derivative n exp(-2t) I_n(2gamma t)/t. Its strict positivity and bounded equilibrium root q^n justify the inverse CDF; exponential age transforms it to the density. Standard Bessel small- and large-time expansions give the complete endpoints and log-corrected equality singularity with the stated constants. Laplace transform solves the exact mean recurrence. Independent finite-state generator comparisons and quadratures (108 tests) support numerical aspects but are not substituted for proof; finite size deviations disclosed.

value.rationale: The foundational 2020 interacting-spin resetting paper asks precisely for the distribution of two-point correlations. The theorem supplies a full nontrivial CDF at each spatial separation and an exact sharp reset-rate boundary rho=2(1-gamma) governing divergence versus vanishing at the equilibrium correlation. At equality a non-obvious positive logarithmic divergence persists, distinct from the source magnetization threshold. These data characterize spatial-order observables beyond mean magnetization; the result is not merely a numerical increment or unmotivated parameter slice.
